items.title: See when an agent is replying
items.detail: After you send a prompt, its row moves to Replies with a spinner until a new assistant message arrives. If sending fails, the row stays where it was.

items.title: The agent list stays up to date
items.detail: New agents appear, changed details update, and retired agents disappear while Tuner is open.

items.title: Send matches the message field
items.detail: Send matches the one-line field height and stays aligned with the last line as the field grows.

items.title: Keep the compact message field full size
items.detail: The empty or one-line message field keeps its full height and rounded ends in compact layouts.

items.title: Keep Chat's layout in step with the keyboard
items.detail: When Tuner returns to the foreground, Chat refreshes its keyboard layout to match the keyboard's current position.

items.title: Keep the message field aligned with the keyboard
items.detail: In compact layouts, the message field follows the keyboard's current visibility while it stays focused.

items.title: The agent list stays where you left it
items.detail: When you return to Tuner, the list stays open, closed, or floating where it was. Rotating while Tuner is active keeps working as before.

items.title: Release notes match the build
items.detail: The What's Changed screen in Tuner and TestFlight show the same notes for this build.
